item.title: Apple Unveils iPhone 18 Pro & Pro Max: Specs & Impact
item.description: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max launch with 6.3‑ and 6.9‑inch displays, A20 Pro chip, up to 30‑hour battery, 48 MP camera, and a 2 TB storage option.

item.title: Apple A20 Pro Chip Brings 2 nm Power to iPhone 18 Pro
item.description: Apple's A20 Pro, the first 2 nm iPhone chip, adds up to 40 % faster GPU, 20 % quicker CPU cores and doubles AI compute for the iPhone 18 Pro line.

item.title: Apple's Hardware Ecosystem: Chips, OS, Connectivity
item.description: Explore how Apple's A20 Pro chip, visionOS 27, and USB‑C integration shape the future of mobile performance, AR experiences, and connectivity for developers.

item.title: Apple’s A20 Pro Chip: What We Know and Why It Matters
item.description: An in‑depth look at Apple’s rumored A20 Pro chip, exploring its potential specs, industry impact, technical challenges, and future roadmap ahead.

item.title: iPhone 18 Pro: 2nm A20 Pro Chip & Camera Controls
item.description: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro brings a 2 nm A20 Pro chip, 6‑core CPU, 7‑core GPU, dual Neural Engine and camera controls that give users creative freedom.

item.title: iPhone 18 Pro & Pro Max: Specs, Pricing & Impact
item.description: Apple unveils the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max with the new A20 Pro chip, longer battery life, new colors, and higher prices starting at $1,199.

item.title: iPhone 18 Pro & Pro Max: AI Camera, A20 Pro & Siri AI
item.description: Apple’s fall “Surprise and Shine” event reveals the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, featuring a 48‑MP variable‑aperture camera, A20 Pro chip, vapor‑chamber cooling, and Siri AI on iOS 27.

item.title: iPhone Air 2 Expected Early 2027 with Five New Upgrades
item.description: Apple’s iPhone Air 2 will debut Q1 2027 with a second 48 MP camera, smaller Dynamic Island, A20 Pro 2 nm chip, upgraded N2 Wi‑Fi/BT and C2 5G modem.

item.title: iPad mini 2024: OLED, A20 Pro Chip & Major Leap
item.description: Apple’s next iPad mini, expected in October, may bring an OLED display, vibration speaker, water resistance and a jump to the A20 Pro processor.
